Benlysta IV is the B-cell-pathway biologic given by infusion for the neighbouring systemic autoimmune disease. Using it keeps both Sjögren's claimants in one price family. Saphnelo's capture of the untreated CDC SLE pool, computed with backend/capture_anchor.py from AZ's filed US revenue ($111m, $260m, $425m, $596m in 2022 to 2025) at a net $35,856 per patient-year with 45.54% stopping each year, was 1.46%, 2.77%, 4.04% and 5.42%. On the fitted curve, reproducing 5.42% in year four needs a peak of 10.45%. JUDGEMENT: multiple 0.375, half of ianalumab's 0.75, giving 0.0392. That converts 2.03% of the untreated eligible pool in dazodalibep's fourth year. Case for more: the Phase 2 placebo-adjusted ESSDAI gain was -2.2 (-6.3 vs -4.1, p=0.0167, Nature Medicine 2024, doi 10.1038/s41591-024-03009-3), about twice ianalumab's Phase 3 gain across trials. It is a new mechanism (CD40L). OASIZ 303 could add the high-symptom population, which ianalumab does not reach until 2029 or later. Case against: it arrives two years after ianalumab. It is an infusion every four weeks against a monthly self-injection. Amgen has not published the OASIZ 301 effect size. Four more mechanisms are in Sjögren's Phase 3 (nipocalimab, deucravacitinib, telitacicept, efgartigimod). This is a late entrant to a crowded class, so the multiple is low. Pool crowding: with ianalumab on indication:85, pool_crowding.solve rations no year (combined starts peak at 11.7% of the eligible pool). Counting the population once trims dazodalibep's peak starts to 0.8692 of its standalone run, because ianalumab has already drawn the pool down.
